overview_description.description: Workhint is Software to Hire, Manage, and Pay on-demand contract staff. It helps companies give their staff the flexibility they want, and give their business the peace of mind to find instant talent placement with one click. Your on-demand staff can view the schedule or detail of Gigs assigned, and clock in and out from the application. The program calculates the time automatically and is credited in wages. A manager dashboard to view all gig workers on-boarded, and assign them for a gig with one click. You can track hours, assign schedules,s and post reviews
